question: In a certain code language, ‘BOOK’ is written as ‘CRTR’. How will ‘PETROL’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘BOOK’ is written as ‘CRTR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eadb7735a85c686e2a209b293633658276d77e328bc85e9cdedc60aa38443da.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/539a54feb5c474d4590550155451ca194f413510309a3bc8cef44bc728fc3ee9.png] 

Hence, 'PETROL' is coded as "**QHYYXW**".
